module_summary: Two-stage pipelined 4-bit multiplier: shifted partial products are pairwise summed into stage registers, then added into the registered product.

anchors.name: mul_a
anchors.why: Multiplicand input, zero-extended and shifted to form partial products.

anchors.name: mul_b
anchors.why: Multiplier input; each bit gates one shifted partial product.

anchors.name: mul_out
anchors.why: Registered final product, sum of the two stage-one partial sums.

anchors.name: mul_result
anchors.why: Array of four shifted partial products selected by mul_b bits.

anchors.name: sum_tmp1
anchors.why: First-stage pipeline register holding sum of partial products 0 and 1; sum_tmp2 is its twin.

anchors.name: mul_a_extend
anchors.why: Zero-extended multiplicand that is shifted into partial products.

groups.name: partial_product_gen
groups.description: Generate loop creating mul_b-gated shifted copies of the extended multiplicand.

groups.name: stage1_adders
groups.description: Registers storing pairwise sums of the four partial products.

groups.name: stage2_output
groups.description: Final adder registering sum_tmp1 plus sum_tmp2 as the product.
